Commentary.Commentary: Now with the Super Over to follow, it will be Netherlands who will batting first as they chased. We will have to wait to find out who comes out to bat and who will bowl the only over for the Windies. Scott Edwards and Logan van Beek to begin. Jason Holder to bowl.

What a game! What a game that was! In the end, it ends in a tie but Netherlands would feel they should have won it in the end. Two brilliant knocks, one from Teja Nidamanuru and the other from Scott Edwards got them back into the game from a very difficult position. However, when both fell, it seemed all over for the Dutch but Logan Van Beek along with the tail, turned the tide yet again towards his side. It came down to 9 needed in the last over. It came to 5 in 5 but in the end, it ended in a tie.

OUT! TAKEN! It is deemed a legal delivery! THE GAME HAS ENDED IN A TIE! SUPER OVER TO FOLLOW! On middle, Logan van Beek swings, it goes more off the inner half towards mid on. Jason Holder runs to his right and takes it. The no ball is checked and replays show it is okay but by just!
